_doc: STAGING. The Card Table rebuilt vocabulary-first. The bench called this list honestly small and refused to pad it — four additions only, duck/void/hoyle/bags. Six boards is what the language supports and that is the whole pack.

theme.name: The Card Table
theme.blurb: Four chairs, a bid you have to make, and a score kept on the back of an envelope.

boards.scene: The bid, and what you did not have

clues.lacked: What your hand did, and the table found out on the fourth book
clues.deal: Clockwise, one at a time, and doing it any other way restarts everything
clues.deck: Cut by the player on the right, and skipping that is worth an argument
clues.ace: Of spades, and the only card whose location everyone is quietly tracking
clues.lead: Whoever took the last book, and never a spade until they are broken
clues.cake: What the last four books were, and saying so out loud invites disaster

clues.blinds: Bidding before you have seen a single card, which is either courage or arithmetic
clues.nil: Zero books, on purpose, and your partner now has to cover you
clues.bid: Said once, out loud, and written down before anyone can revise it
clues.blind: The variant where you and your partner both go without looking
clues.slid: The envelope across the table, with the running score on the back
clues.bind: What a nil bid puts your partner in for the entire hand

clues.lapsed: Your attention, for one card, and the table has been waiting for this
clues.spade: Followed if you have one. Failing to is the offence with a name
clues.deal: What the accused was doing when this started, allegedly badly
clues.lead: Went out, and somebody did not follow suit, and somebody else noticed
clues.pads: Where the score lives, and the handwriting on it is being disputed
clues.pale: What the accused goes, briefly, before deciding on total denial

boards.scene: The hand you did nothing to deserve

clues.lucked: Into it, and pretending otherwise is the etiquette
clues.deck: Shuffled seven times by the one player who read that somewhere
clues.duck: Under a book you could take, to set up a later one, and it looks like a mistake
clues.clue: What your partner is trying to send with the card they just played
clues.cued: What that was, and reading it wrong loses the hand and the peace
clues.luck: Named out loud only by the person who did not have it

clues.pasted: What the other team just did to you, by three books
clues.spade: Broken on the second trick, which nobody at this table thinks is fair
clues.set: Short of your bid, and it costs you what you bid and then some
clues.seat: Swapped after, on the theory that it is the chair and not the play
clues.pest: The kibitzer behind you, who has opinions and no cards
clues.taped: The corner of the box, holding together a deck older than the table

clues.cradle: Where you learned it, roughly, watching from somebody's lap
clues.ace: The first card you were allowed to hold, turned inward, saying nothing
clues.card: Handed to you at eight, in a hand of four, by an aunt with no patience
clues.deal: The first thing you were taught, and badly, for about a year
clues.lead: The second thing, and the one that takes ten years
clues.clear: What the rules never were, because every house plays them differently
